description: Source file implementing classes and methods for flow graph nodes and ports in an audio processing framework, including data pulling, resetting, and connection management.

classes.name: FlowGraphNode
classes.description: Represents a node in an audio processing flow graph, managing data pulling and reset logic.

classes.name: FlowGraphPortFloat
classes.description: Represents a float audio port associated with a flow graph node, managing buffer allocation.

classes.name: FlowGraphPortFloatOutput
classes.description: Output port for float audio data, capable of pulling data and managing connections.

classes.name: FlowGraphPortFloatInput
classes.description: Input port for float audio data, capable of pulling data from connected ports.

classes.name: FlowGraphSink
classes.description: Specialized node for consuming audio data, providing a pullData method.

methods.name: FlowGraphNode::pullData
methods.description: Pulls audio data from upstream nodes, handling recursion prevention and processing.

methods.name: FlowGraphNode::pullReset
methods.description: Resets the node and upstream nodes, preventing cyclic recursion.

methods.name: FlowGraphNode::reset
methods.description: Resets internal counters for the node.

methods.name: FlowGraphPortFloat::FlowGraphPortFloat
methods.description: Constructor initializing a float port with buffer allocation.

methods.name: FlowGraphPortFloatOutput::pullData
methods.description: Pulls data from the containing node, limited by buffer size.

methods.name: FlowGraphPortFloatOutput::connect
methods.description: Connects this output port to an input port.

methods.name: FlowGraphPortFloatOutput::disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects this output port from an input port.

methods.name: FlowGraphPortFloatInput::pullData
methods.description: Pulls data from connected port or returns min of buffer size and requested frames.

methods.name: FlowGraphPortFloatInput::pullReset
methods.description: Resets the connected port if any.

methods.name: FlowGraphPortFloatInput::getBuffer
methods.description: Returns buffer pointer, either from self or connected port.

methods.name: FlowGraphSink::pullData
methods.description: Pulls data from the node, incrementing call count.
